comes_from_behind_back.about: Back in running a horse that has won at least min_comebacks times after drifting to double its starting price in running, once its back price reaches drift_multiple x its last pre-race price (capped at max_price).

folds_when_short_lay.about: Lay in running a horse that has traded 1.5 or shorter and lost at least half the time, once its lay price is at or below lay_at_or_below. Needs the LIVE app key to mean anything: the delayed key's prices lag the race.

front_runner_course_bias.about: Back the only habitual front-runner in a race at a course where front-runners win more than average. Paper bet struck in the last 5 minutes before the off if the best back price is between min_price and max_price.

trend_top_pick.about: Back the dashboard's clear top pick on the trends (5/7 or 5/6 and above) in the last 5 minutes before the off.
